consistency_note: Close-ups and the 'Krishna lifts the hill' climax use primary_portrait (Kangra, Cleveland 2001.45) so his face is the same in every tight shot. The other miniatures paint Krishna differently (blue vs grey skin), so they are used only for wide group/symbolic shots where the face is small.
